🚀 Calling All Startups from Central Eurasia! 🌍

Silkroad Innovation Hub is thrilled to announce our return to one of the biggest tech conferences in the world - TechCrunch Disrupt 2024! 🎉

Last year, in partnership with Astana Hub and IT Park, we brought the largest cohort of startups from Central Eurasia to TechCrunch Disrupt 2023, and this year, we’re doing it again! Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to showcase your innovative ideas on a global stage.

Details:

📅 Date: October 28-30, 2024
📍 Location: Moscone Center, San Francisco, CA

Qualifications:

Stage: Early to growth-stage startups.
Team: A passionate and driven team ready to make an impact.

Application Deadline:

⏰ Apply by: August 15, 2024

Apply here:

www.tc24.slkrd.io

Don’t miss out on this amazing opportunity to connect with investors, industry leaders, and fellow innovators! 

👉 Apply Now and be a part of TechCrunch Disrupt 2024! 🚀
